svg.title: Full neighbor mesh: every neuron and connection
svg.desc: 14 ordinary operand bits, 64 hidden layers of 128 neurons, and 97 output neurons. Each neuron has exactly two incoming activation connections and its own bias. No connections are omitted. Zoom to inspect nodes and their parent tooltips.

g.text: 14 input bits · 64 hidden layers × 128 neurons · 97 outputs
16578 connections · 8289 biases · 24867 parameters · all connections shown
Connections point from left to right. Zoom to inspect.
